zionsville.heroDek: Zionsville sits about 15 miles northwest of downtown Indianapolis, with Carmel bordering it to the east along US-421 and I-65 running through town, in Boone County. Population rose from 8,775 in 2000 to 14,160 in 2010, 30,603 in 2020, and an estimated 33,624 as of mid-2025 — though a meaningful share of that increase reflects annexations that expanded the town's land area past 67 square miles, not organic growth alone. Zionsville was founded in 1852 and incorporated as a town in 1866.
